title: Employ staff under the Mannequins and Models Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Mannequins and Models Award 2020.

sources.title: Mannequins and Models Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This occupational award covers employers throughout Australia who employ mannequins and models to the exclusion of any other modern award.

assessment.summary: The Mannequins and Models Award sets classifications, minimum pay and allowances for employed mannequins and models.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
